title: Check mail every 15 minutes in work hours, stay asleep when nothing's new
source: x-usage #3: mail preflight check so empty ticks wake no model and send nothing; one ping when something real arrives; 'checked at' visible.

chat.goal: Have the inbox checked every 15 minutes during the day, but only bother you (or wake the AI) when something new actually came in.
chat.opener: can you check my inbox every 15 min during the day but don't wake yourself up unless something new actually came in
chat.label: setup

mail.subject: Can we move Monday?
mail.body: Aisha, I've been called to an exam board on Monday at 1. Could we do Tuesday 2pm instead? Eleanor

checks.label: uses a mail check, not blind wakes

judge: Pip makes a 15-minute work-hours routine gated on new mail, says it will only speak up when something arrives, stays silent for the empty hour, then pings once about Dr Marsh's request with a short suggested reply.
